title: Cycling Across Town
sentences: For years, I drove to work every morning, even though the traffic drove me crazy.
Eventually, I decided to try cycling instead, mostly to save money on petrol.
The first few rides were exhausting, and my legs ached for days afterward.
Although the route crosses a busy bridge, I've learned which lanes feel safest.
While I'm cycling, I notice things about the city that I never saw from a car.
It usually takes about the same amount of time as driving during rush hour.
If it's raining heavily, I still take the bus, since cycling feels too risky then.
Since I started cycling, I've felt fitter and less stressed before work begins.
My colleagues were surprised at first, but a few of them have started cycling too.
Occasionally, I miss the comfort of sitting in a warm car during winter.
Even so, I can't imagine going back to sitting in traffic every single day.
